title: If a bogie-hearth furnace quote includes a quench tank, does it also include external cooling?
summary: A quench tank may be included while external cooling remains the user's responsibility. Suneng's bogie-hearth furnace proposal lists the tank, agitators and support platform, but separately states “quench-oil tank cooling system: user-supplied”. Separate internal tank equipment from external cooling when defining the complete supply, and reconcile the medium and batch-loading conditions.
